landing.heroTitle: Manage your clients, routines and payments
landing.heroSubtitle: The all-in-one platform that lets you create professional routines, track your clients and get paid automatically. No hassle.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for your fitness business
landing.featureRoutinesTitle: Create professional routines in minutes, not hours
landing.featureRoutinesSubtitle: Set up exercises, sets, reps, rest periods and send it. Your client receives it instantly in their app.
landing.featureRoutinesBullet1: Library with hundreds of exercises with video
landing.featureNutritionTitle: Meal plans your clients will love
landing.featureNutritionSubtitle: Create meal plans with macros calculated to the gram. Your client gets a visual, easy-to-follow plan.
landing.featureNutritionBullet1: Meals with detailed foods, calories and macros
landing.featureNutritionBullet4: Real-time macro view while building the plan
landing.featureClientAppTitle: Your clients train with an app that looks like yours
landing.featureClientAppSubtitle: A premium experience that makes you look professional. Available on any device.
landing.featurePaymentsTitle: Get paid without lifting a finger. Literally.
landing.featurePaymentsSubtitle: Set the price, enable automatic billing and forget about it. Stripe handles the rest.
landing.featureTrackingTitle: Know exactly how your clients train
landing.featureTrackingSubtitle: Session notes, integrated chat and progress metrics. All in one place.
landing.step1Desc: Create your account in 30 seconds. No credit card needed.
landing.step2Desc: Customize your space and create your pricing plans.
landing.step3Desc: Send them the link. They access the app and that's it.
landing.step4Desc: Create routines, track progress and get paid automatically.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start free and scale when you need to. No surprises.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
landing.faq1Answer: Yes. The free plan includes 2 clients, routine builder and the client app. No credit card, no time limit.
landing.faq2Question: Do my clients need to download anything?
landing.faq2Answer: No. TrainHub is a progressive web app (PWA). Your clients just need to open the link in their browser and can add it to their home screen like a native app.
landing.faq3Question: Can I migrate my current routines?
landing.faq3Answer: Yes. You can create routines from scratch with our visual builder or import exercises from our library with over 50 base exercises. Your library grows with every exercise you create.
landing.faq4Answer: On the Pro and Business plans, you can set up automatic monthly billing for your clients. They receive a notification and pay directly. You just focus on training.
landing.faq5Question: Can I customize the app with my brand?
landing.faq5Answer: On the Business plan you get full white label: your logo, your colors, your domain. On the Pro plan you can customize your profile and your clients' experience.
landing.faq6Answer: All plans include access to our documentation and community. Pro and Business plans have priority chat support. The Business plan includes dedicated support with guaranteed response time.
landing.problem1: Wasting time creating routines in Word or PDFs
landing.problem3: Not knowing if your clients actually train
landing.problem4: Looking unprofessional compared to the competition
landing.solution4: Professional app with your personal brand
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join hundreds of trainers who already manage their clients, routines and payments from a single platform. Free to start.
landing.ctaTrust: No credit card · 2 free clients · Set up in 5 minutes
landing.footerDescription: The all-in-one platform for personal trainers who want to grow.
